text_nodes.text: The release names the National Science Foundation up top. The Department of Justice is a footnote.
Deb has already begun testing the system with the Fort Worth Police Department*, helping to develop training using real-life scenarios with prompts based on the principles of de-escalation.

The AI can tell when an officer is being kind and listening, when the officer picks up on something the person wants to talk about and follows that conversation, and when the officer doesn't connect with the person.
Then, the AI steers the interaction accordingly, giving officers perspective and practice in an environment where they can learn the skills they need for those high-pressure interactions.
